title: Vikram and Betal: The Two Brothers
moral: True wealth lies in kindness and honesty.

scenes.summary: Betal tells a story about two brothers.
scenes.text: Betal told Vikram about two brothers, one greedy and one kind.
scenes.image_prompt: vikram carrying betal in forest cartoon style

scenes.summary: The elder brother takes more than his share.
scenes.text: The elder brother secretly took more land and money.
scenes.image_prompt: elder brother hiding money while younger looks unaware cartoon

scenes.text: The younger brother worked hard and stayed honest.
scenes.image_prompt: younger brother farming land happily cartoon

scenes.text: The elder brother lost his wealth due to greed.
scenes.image_prompt: elder brother looking sad after losing wealth cartoon

scenes.text: Vikram said the younger brother was truly rich. Betal flew away again.
scenes.image_prompt: betal flying away while vikram stands calm cartoon

story: Two brothers chose different paths—one greedy, one kind. The greedy one lost everything, while the kind one succeeded. Vikram said true wealth is kindness, and Betal flew away.
